description: This line plot illustrates the average repetition rate across different relation categories for various experimental configurations related to relation extraction. The x-axis, labeled "Relation Category," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks appearing at regular intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled "Average Repetition Rate," also uses a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains six distinct lines: a solid blue line with circular markers representing "w/o DPO obo"; a solid orange line with triangular markers representing "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint"; a solid green line with circular markers representing "DPO"; a dashed blue line with circular markers representing the "Average of w/o DPO obo"; a dotted orange line with triangular markers representing the "Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint"; and a dashed green line with circular markers representing the "Average of DPO". The solid blue line ("w/o DPO obo") starts at approximately 0.227, peaks at 0.6 near the x-axis value of 1, then declines to near zero around x=50 before ending at approximately 0.02. The solid orange line ("w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint") starts near 0.227, exhibits significant fluctuations, reaching a peak of approximately 0.48 near x=30, and ends near 0.16. The solid green line ("DPO") remains relatively stable, starting near 0.163 and ending near 0.117. The dashed blue line ("Average of w/o DPO obo") is a horizontal line at approximately 0.163. The dotted orange line ("Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint") is a horizontal line at approximately 0.16. The dashed green line ("Average of DPO") is a horizontal line at approximately 0.117.
